details:
ASTROVITAL X is an AI-powered space healthcare and astronaut monitoring system designed to monitor astronauts’ health during space missions. It analyzes available health data, identifies unusual readings, detects potential health risks and generates alerts for medical experts. It provides separate dashboards for astronauts and doctors to support health monitoring and remote medical supervision.

The project helps address challenges such as limited medical facilities, microgravity effects, stress and delayed medical assistance. Its main benefits include early risk detection, mental wellness monitoring and improved emergency response.

Our innovation combines Artificial Intelligence, health monitoring and human medical expertise into one software-based platform without requiring additional dedicated medical hardware. We considered data availability, astronaut safety, system scalability, sustainability and future integration with spacecraft health systems.

The project follows a modular, cloud-compatible software architecture. It is designed for future expansion to submarines, Antarctic research stations and other isolated environments.

NASA’s Human Research Program hazards informed the project context; all health readings shown are synthetic demonstration data.
